title: Crows remember your face for years
topic: Crows recognise individual human faces, hold the grudge for years, and pass it to birds that were never there
voice_script: A crow can remember your face for years. Researchers in Seattle wore a mask while trapping crows, then released them and walked the campus. Years later, crows still dive-bombed that mask on sight. So did birds that had never been trapped at all. The scolding spread outward through the population, year after year. Most of those crows had never seen the trapping. They learned the face secondhand, from other crows. The grudge outlived the birds that earned it.
